title:
一、英譯中：請將下列英文句子譯成中文。（15 分）
Throughout human history, there have been a number of pandemics of diseases such as smallpox and tuberculosis. The most fatal pandemic in recorded history was the Black Death (also known as The Plague), which killed an estimated 75–200 million people in the 14th century. Current pandemics include COVID-19 and AIDS.
answer: 縱觀人類歷史，曾出現多次疾病大流行，例如天花與肺結核。有紀錄以來最致命的大流行是黑死病（又稱鼠疫），十四世紀時估計造成七千五百萬至兩億人死亡。目前的大流行則包括 COVID-19 與愛滋病。
hint:
句構拆解
  • Throughout human history, there have been a number of pandemics of diseases such as smallpox and tuberculosis.：there have been＝曾經有（現在完成式）；a number of＝若干、多次。
  • The most fatal pandemic in recorded history was the Black Death (also known as The Plague)：主幹（史上最致命的大流行是黑死病）；in recorded history＝有紀錄以來；also known as＝又稱。
  • which killed an estimated 75–200 million people in the 14th century：關係子句修飾 the Black Death；an estimated＝估計約。
  • Current pandemics include COVID-19 and AIDS.：include 後面接例子。
關鍵詞
  • pandemic 大流行（疾病）
  • smallpox 天花；tuberculosis 肺結核
  • fatal 致命的；the Black Death 黑死病；the Plague 鼠疫
  • an estimated 75–200 million 估計七千五百萬至兩億
翻譯技巧
  • 數字區間 75–200 million 中文習慣說「七千五百萬至兩億」，比「7,500 萬到 2 億」更順。
  • 「which killed...」不宜直譯「它殺死了」，譯「造成……死亡」較符合中文。
  • in recorded history 譯「有紀錄以來」，不要譯「在記錄的歷史中」。
易錯點
  • 把 pandemic 譯成「流行病」——pandemic 是指「全球大流行」，epidemic 才是「流行病」。
  • Black Death 與 The Plague 是同一事件，中文用括號「（又稱鼠疫）」即可。

title:
二、中譯英：請將下列中文句子譯成英文。（15 分）
長榮海運貨櫃船在蘇伊士運河擱淺，之後運河堵住了 6 天，其他船隻無法繞行長賜輪。此運河是世界上最繁忙的貿易路線之一，其阻塞對歐洲與亞洲及中東之間的貿易產生了重大影響。（長賜輪：the Ever Given）
answer: The Ever Given, a container ship operated by Evergreen Marine, ran aground in the Suez Canal. The canal was then blocked for six days, and other vessels could not sail around the Ever Given. As one of the world's busiest trade routes, the canal's blockage had a major impact on trade between Europe, Asia and the Middle East.
hint:
句構策略
  • 原文三句，英文也建議三句：①擱淺；②運河堵塞六天、其他船無法繞行；③運河地位＋影響。
  • 「長榮海運貨櫃船」→ The Ever Given, a container ship operated by Evergreen Marine（用同位語說明船名與營運公司）。
  • 「擱淺」→ ran aground（固定用法）。
  • 「堵住了 6 天」→ was blocked for six days。
  • 「無法繞行長賜輪」→ could not sail around the Ever Given。
  • 「其阻塞對……產生重大影響」→ the blockage had a major impact on trade between...。
關鍵詞
  • 貨櫃船 container ship；海運業者 shipping company／Evergreen Marine
  • 蘇伊士運河 the Suez Canal
  • 擱淺 run aground
  • 貿易路線 trade route；繁忙的 busiest
  • 重大影響 have a major impact on
易錯點
  • 「長榮海運」不要直譯 Evergreen Shipping——正式名稱是 Evergreen Marine。
  • 「繞行」不是 go around 就好，海運語境用 sail around。
  • 「歐洲與亞洲及中東」→ between Europe, Asia and the Middle East（between 後面用 and 連接最後一項）。

title:
三、英文作文：（20 分）
Write an English composition in about 200 words on one of the environmental issues in Taiwan. Identify the problem, propose a solution, and imagine its consequence. Give a title to your composition to attract the reader's attention.
answer:
Title: The Cup We Drink From for Five Minutes and Live With for Five Hundred Years

Taiwan's most visible environmental problem is not in the mountains or the sea; it is in our hands. Every day, millions of disposable drink cups are handed across counters, used for a few minutes, and thrown away. Only a small fraction is actually recycled, because the plastic lining makes the paper cups difficult to process. The rest is incinerated, buried, or blown into rivers and eventually into the ocean.

The solution does not require a new technology. Taiwan already has one of the world's densest convenience-store networks and a highly effective recycling culture, so a deposit-refund system for drink cups could work here better than almost anywhere else. Customers would pay a small deposit, return the cup to any participating store, and receive the money back. Reusable-cup lending, similar to bike-sharing, could cover the rest.

The consequence of doing nothing is easy to imagine: more microplastics in seafood, higher waste-disposal costs, and a coastline that tourists photograph for the wrong reasons. The consequence of acting is equally clear. If Taiwan solves the disposable-cup problem, it would show that a small, dense island can turn a daily habit into a national habit of care—and that is a model worth exporting.
hint:
審題
  • 三個必答要素：問題（identify the problem）、解方（propose a solution）、後果（imagine its consequence）。
  • 必須自訂標題，且標題要能吸引讀者（可用對比、數字、問句）。
  • 字數約 200 字。
四段架構
  • 第一段（問題）：具體描述（一次性飲料杯、塑膠淋膜難回收、焚化或流入海洋）。
  • 第二段（解方）：押金退還制＋循環杯借還（搭配台灣便利商店密度與回收文化）。
  • 第三段（後果）：不行動的代價（微塑膠、處理成本、觀光形象）；行動的效益（可輸出他國的模式）。
  • 標題：用「五分鐘 vs 五百年」的對比抓住注意力。
關鍵詞彙
  • disposable cup 一次性杯子；plastic lining 塑膠淋膜
  • incinerate 焚化；landfill 掩埋場
  • deposit-refund system 押金退還制
  • reusable-cup lending 循環杯借用
  • microplastics 微塑膠；waste-disposal costs 廢棄物處理成本
加分句型
  • Taiwan's most visible environmental problem is not in the mountains or the sea; it is in our hands.（對比開場）
  • Only a small fraction is actually recycled, because...（指出盲點）
  • The consequence of doing nothing is easy to imagine...（假設後果）
  • ...a small, dense island can turn a daily habit into a national habit of care（結尾升华）
評分重點
  • 標題必須有；無標題會直接扣分。
  • 問題、解方、後果三要素缺一不可。
  • 用字具體（disposable, deposit-refund, microplastics），避免 good/bad。

title: Several stylish ______ can be found on the chairs on display, even though one could easily recognize the prototype.
hint:
1. Several stylish variations can be found on the chairs on display, even though one could easily recognize the prototype.
（展示的椅子上可以看到幾種時尚的變化款式，儘管仍能輕易認出原型。）
  • 考點：variations＝變化、變體（variation 的複數）；此處指「不同款式」。
  • 線索：even though one could recognize the prototype（仍認得出原型）→ 表示是同款的不同「變化版」。
  • 其他選項：visionaries 有遠見的人；vocations 職業、志業；valuations 估價。
  • 例句：The design comes in several variations.（這款設計有幾種變化版本。）
撇步
  • 原型（prototype）的對照是「variations」。

title: Our manager often meditates for about twenty minutes right in his office; afterwards, one could clearly see that he has this ______ look on his face.
hint:
2. ...afterwards, one could clearly see that he has this radiant look on his face.
（之後可以清楚看到他臉上有這種容光煥發的神情。）
  • 考點：radiant（形容詞）＝容光煥發的、燦爛的；須用形容詞修飾 look。
  • 線索：meditates（冥想）→ 之後神情「平和、發光」。
  • 其他選項：radiate（動詞，散發）；radish（名詞，蘿蔔）；ragged（形容詞，破爛的、疲憊的）。
  • 例句：She had a radiant smile after the good news.（聽到好消息後她笑容燦爛。）
撇步
  • 詞性判斷：look 前要形容詞 → radiant（不是動詞 radiate）。

title: The robber ______ ran into the police when he was just about to turn around a corner where he was trying to escape with his raid.
hint:
3. The robber incidentally ran into the police when he was just about to turn around a corner where he was trying to escape with his raid.
（搶匪正要在轉角處逃跑時，碰巧撞上警察。）
  • 考點：incidentally＝偶然地、碰巧地。
  • 線索：just about to turn around a corner（正要轉彎）→ 遇上警察是「碰巧」。
  • 其他選項：immensely 極度地；implicitly 隱含地；indifferently 漠不關心地。
  • 例句：I incidentally met an old friend at the airport.（我碰巧在機場遇到老友。）
撇步
  • 偶然、碰巧＝incidentally / by chance / accidentally。

title: Chemotherapy did not make John feel better. Instead, his health started to ______ soon after.
hint:
4. Chemotherapy did not make John feel better. Instead, his health started to deteriorate soon after.
（化療沒有讓約翰好轉。相反地，他的健康不久後開始惡化。）
  • 考點：deteriorate＝惡化、變壞。
  • 線索：did not make him feel better＋Instead（相反地）→ 健康「惡化」。
  • 其他選項：underscore 強調；illustrate 說明；stimulate 刺激。
  • 例句：His health deteriorated rapidly.（他的健康迅速惡化。）
撇步
  • 健康、病情、品質「惡化」→ deteriorate（名詞 deterioration）。

title: The journalist was finally caught ______ all the stories he had made up for the newspaper he worked for.
hint:
5. The journalist was finally caught fabricating all the stories he had made up for the newspaper he worked for.
（這名記者終於被抓到為他任職的報社捏造所有那些編造的故事。）
  • 考點：fabricate＝捏造、編造（fabricate stories／evidence）；be caught + V-ing＝被抓到正在做某事。
  • 線索：made up（編造）＋journalist（記者）→ 捏造新聞。
  • 其他選項：dazzle 使炫目；equate 等同；grease 塗油、賄賂。
  • 例句：He was caught fabricating data.（他被抓到捏造數據。）
撇步
  • 新聞、數據、證據「捏造」→ fabricate。

title: Even in the face of personal ______, she does not see herself as totally defeated. She does what she can to make the world a better place.
hint:
6. Even in the face of personal adversity, she does not see herself as totally defeated.
（即使面對個人的逆境，她也不認為自己完全被打敗。）
  • 考點：adversity＝逆境、厄運；in the face of adversity＝面對逆境。
  • 線索：Even in the face of...＋not totally defeated（未被完全打敗）→ 一定是「逆境」。
  • 其他選項：contribution 貢獻；denomination 面額、教派；opulence 富裕。
  • 例句：She showed courage in the face of adversity.（她在逆境中展現勇氣。）
撇步
  • 「面對逆境」固定說 in the face of adversity。

title: Although many people still view Bosnia with ______, its dramatic landscapes and singular history are making it an increasingly popular destination.
hint:
7. Although many people still view Bosnia with trepidation, its dramatic landscapes and singular history are making it an increasingly popular destination.
（儘管許多人仍帶著忐忑不安的心情看待波士尼亞，它戲劇性的地景與獨特的歷史正使它成為越來越受歡迎的目的地。）
  • 考點：trepidation＝不安、恐懼（with trepidation＝忐忑地）。
  • 線索：Although...（儘管）→ 前後對比：仍有「不安」，但已成熱門景點。
  • 其他選項：ingenuity 獨創性；proximity 鄰近；revelation 揭露。
  • 例句：She opened the letter with trepidation.（她忐忑不安地打開那封信。）
撇步
  • 「帶著不安」→ with trepidation（近義：apprehension）。

title: What you are getting now is a ______ schedule for events in the coming year, which should be finalized by the end of this month.
hint:
8. What you are getting now is a tentative schedule for events in the coming year, which should be finalized by the end of this month.
（你現在拿到的是明年度活動的暫定時程，月底前應該會定案。）
  • 考點：tentative＝暫定的、暫時的；a tentative schedule＝暫定時程。
  • 線索：should be finalized by the end of this month（月底前定案）→ 現在還是「暫定」。
  • 其他選項：permanent 永久的；terminal 終點的；deviating 偏離的。
  • 例句：We have made tentative plans for July.（我們七月有暫定計畫。）
撇步
  • 還沒定案 → tentative；定案 → finalize。

title: When traveling along the coast, we ______ across the ruins of an old fort and enjoyed the historical site.
hint:
9. When traveling along the coast, we stumbled across the ruins of an old fort and enjoyed the historical site.
（沿著海岸旅行時，我們偶然發現一座舊堡壘的遺跡，並參觀了這個歷史景點。）
  • 考點：stumble across/upon＝偶然發現、無意間遇到。
  • 線索：traveling along the coast（沿著海岸旅行）＋ruins（遺跡）→ 無意間「發現」。
  • 其他選項：sneak 偷偷摸摸；skip 跳過；scramble 攀爬、匆忙移動。
  • 例句：I stumbled across an old photo in the drawer.（我在抽屜裡偶然發現一張舊照片。）
撇步
  • 偶然發現＝stumble across / come across。

title: Your visa expired 7 months ago. It is not ______ anymore. You need to apply for a new one.
hint:
10. Your visa expired 7 months ago. It is not valid anymore. You need to apply for a new one.
（你的簽證七個月前就過期了。它已經無效，你需要重新申請。）
  • 考點：valid＝有效的；expired（過期）為其反義。
  • 線索：visa expired（簽證過期）→ 已「無效」。
  • 其他選項：vacant 空的；variable 可變的；verified 已驗證的。
  • 例句：My passport is valid until 2030.（我的護照效期到 2030 年。）
撇步
  • 簽證、護照、票券「有效」→ valid；「過期」→ expire。

title: A significant event that marked me indelibly occurred when I was twelve. That year my school held a music    11    and I was one of the students chosen to play the piano. I managed to get up the steps to the stage without any problem, but as I walked across the stage, I fell. Out of the audience, a voice said loudly and clearly, “Ayah! A baikah shouldn't be allowed to perform in public” I got up before anyone could get on stage to help me and, with tears    12    uncontrollably down my face, I rushed to the piano and began to play. Beethoven's “Fur Elise” had never been played so    13    fast before or since, but I managed to finish the whole piece. That I managed to do so made me feel really strong. I never again feared    14   . In later years I was reminded of this experience from time to time. During my fourth year as an assistant professor at the University of California at Berkeley, I won a    15    teaching award.

subItems.hint:
11. That year my school held a music recital and I was one of the students chosen to play the piano.
（那年學校舉辦音樂演奏會，我是被選中彈鋼琴的學生之一。）
  • 考點：recital＝獨奏會、演奏會（music recital）。
  • 線索：music ___ ＋ chosen to play the piano（被選中彈琴）→ 音樂演奏會。
  • 其他選項：citadel 城堡；script 劇本；score 樂譜、分數。
撇步
  • 鋼琴、聲樂的「發表會」→ recital。

12. ...with tears streaming uncontrollably down my face, I rushed to the piano and began to play.
（眼淚不受控制地流下臉頰，我衝向鋼琴開始彈奏。）
  • 考點：with tears streaming down one's face＝淚流滿面（with + 受詞 + 現在分詞，表伴隨狀態）。
  • 線索：uncontrollably（不受控制地）＋tears → 眼淚「流」下。
  • 其他選項：blur（使模糊）；rise（上升）；fleet（迅速掠過）。
撇步
  • 眼淚、汗水「流下」→ stream / run down；with + N + V-ing 是常見描寫句型。

13. Beethoven's “Fur Elise” had never been played so fiendishly fast before or since.
（貝多芬的《給愛麗絲》從來沒有被彈得這麼瘋狂地快，之後也不曾如此。）
  • 考點：fiendishly＝極度地、瘋狂地（口語強調，修飾 fast）。
  • 線索：never been played so ___ fast（從未彈得這麼……快）→ 強調「瘋狂地」。
  • 其他選項：categorically 明確地；adversely 不利地；transiently 短暫地。
撇步
  • 修飾形容詞的強調副詞：fiendishly / incredibly / ridiculously + adj.。

14. I never again feared ridicule.
（我再也不怕被嘲笑。）
  • 考點：ridicule＝嘲笑、訕笑（動詞也是 ridicule）。
  • 線索：前文觀眾大聲說「A baikah shouldn't be allowed to perform in public」（這種人不該公開演出）→ 這是「嘲笑」，作者之後不再害怕。
  • 其他選項：research 研究；rigor 嚴格；rebellion 反叛。
撇步
  • 被人當眾羞辱 → ridicule（近義：mockery）。

15. During my fourth year as an assistant professor..., I won a distinguished teaching award.
（在柏克萊擔任助理教授的第四年，我獲得了一項傑出教學獎。）
  • 考點：distinguished（形容詞）＝傑出的、卓越的；distinguished teaching award＝傑出教學獎。
  • 干擾：distinguishing（現在分詞，區別的）；extinguished（被熄滅的）；extinguishing（正在熄滅的）。
撇步
  • 獎項名稱裡的「傑出」→ distinguished；「熄滅」才是 extinguish。

title:
For most pet lovers, pets are parts of the family. For some, pets are even more important than family members. They see pets as indispensable partners, and spoil and love them as much as or more than parents do their kids. Therefore, their mission in life becomes    16    their pet's well-being, and making sure they stay healthy and active.

For instance, pet lovers often wish to    17    what their pets do when they are away. In order to    18    their pets, a new technology called a “smart collar” was developed. This wearable    19    enables pet owners to follow their pets' activities. It can also observe pets' health and exercise habits. Voyce Health Monitor, which collects health information about a dog, is an example.

In addition to following pets' behavior and gathering pets' health information, some products feature a microphone and built-in speaker which allow pet owners to communicate with their pets when they are not present. The    20    in technology have made the relationship between pets and their owners more convenient and accessible.

subItems.hint:
16. ...their mission in life becomes looking after their pet's well-being...
（他們人生的使命就變成照顧寵物的健康福祉……）
  • 考點：look after＝照顧（＝take care of）；空格後接 their pet's well-being。
  • 其他選項：look away 移開視線；look down 俯視、輕視；look up 查閱、仰望。
撇步
  • 照顧＝look after / take care of。

17. For instance, pet lovers often wish to monitor what their pets do when they are away.
（例如，寵物飼主常希望能監看寵物在他們不在時做什麼。）
  • 考點：monitor＝監看、監測（後接子句或名詞）。
  • 線索：what their pets do when they are away（不在時寵物做什麼）→ 需要「監看」。
  • 其他選項：maintain 維持；migrate 遷徙；moderate 緩和、主持。
撇步
  • 追蹤行為、健康數據 → monitor（名詞 monitor 是螢幕、監測器）。

18. In order to keep track of their pets, a new technology called a “smart collar” was developed.
（為了掌握寵物的行蹤，一種稱為「智慧項圈」的新技術被開發出來。）
  • 考點：keep track of＝掌握……的行蹤、持續追蹤。
  • 其他選項：get rid of 擺脫；do justice to 公平對待、充分展現；make way for 讓路給。
撇步
  • 追蹤、記錄＝keep track of（反義 lose track of）。

19. This wearable device enables pet owners to follow their pets' activities.
（這個穿戴式裝置讓飼主能追蹤寵物的活動。）
  • 考點：device＝裝置、設備；wearable device＝穿戴式裝置。
  • 線索：wearable（可穿戴的）＋smart collar（智慧項圈）→ 是「裝置」。
  • 其他選項：component 零件；inventory 庫存；issue 議題。
撇步
  • 電子產品、器材 → device；零件是 component。

20. The advances in technology have made the relationship between pets and their owners more convenient and accessible.
（科技的進步讓寵物與飼主的關係更便利、更易親近。）
  • 考點：advances＝進步、進展（advance 的複數）；advances in technology＝科技進步。
  • 其他選項：impediments 障礙（反義）；responses 回應；fulfillments 實現、滿足。
撇步
  • 「科技進步」＝advances in technology（＝technological advances）。

title:
A Tokyo-bound flight made a U-turn while flying over the Pacific Ocean and returned to Los Angeles because one passenger, for reasons still unclear, had boarded the wrong flight. All Nippon Airways Flight 175 left the Los Angeles International Airport at about 11:30 a.m. Tuesday Pacific Standard Time, spent about eight hours in the air and landed back in California just after 7:30 p.m., majorly inconveniencing its passengers, including model Chrissy Teigen, who live-tweeted the “flight to nowhere” to her 9.2 million followers. Teigen, who was traveling with her husband John Legend, wrote on Twitter that the plane was turned around about four hours into the flight. The Twitter world watched in amusement as Teigen kept her followers updated on the ordeal, which apparently involved an hours-long wait at the airport, unanswered questions, some police presence and a microwavable Ramen meal.

The incident involved two brothers, one of whom was an authorized All Nippon Airways, or ANA, passenger while the other had a United Airlines ticket, Transportation Security Administration spokesman Mike England said.

The brothers, who were not identified, went through security screening without incident and had valid passports and boarding passes. Both were headed to Tokyo and were scheduled to leave around the same time. Both ended up on the ANA flight even though only one of them was an authorized passenger. It remains unclear how that happened. The airline said the decision to turn around was part of a security procedure.

Weather concerns, mechanical problems, medical issues and terrorist threats are among the common reasons for diverting a plane. Others are unusual, but not unheard of.

In 2015, for example, a British Airways flight flew back to Heathrow Airport just 30 minutes into the seven-hour flight to Dubai because of an overwhelming odor coming from the lavatory. A similar incident happened earlier this year, when a SpiceJet flight headed to New Delhi was diverted because of a “very foul smell” coming from the lavatory.

subItems.title: 21. What is the main subject of this passage?
subItems.hint:
→ Unusual flights.
（這篇文章的主旨是什麼？→ 不尋常的航班。）
  • 定位：第一段開頭就是「一架飛往東京的班機在半途折返」，原因是有人「上錯飛機」；第四段更明說「Others are unusual, but not unheard of」，並舉了兩起「廁所異味」折返的案例。
  • 主旨：全文談的是各種罕見的航班折返原因。
  • 其他選項：旅客抱怨、暴力對待、客戶導向服務——都不是全文主軸。
撇步
  • 主旨題看首段＋重複出現的關鍵詞：U-turn、diverting、unusual。

subItems.title: 22. What is the main reason for the ANA flight to turn back to Los Angeles?

options.text: The famous model Chrissy Teigen attracted 9.2 million followers on Twitter.
The Security Administration Mike England needed to investigate the two brothers.
The airline was required to check the overwhelming odor in the lavatory.
One of the two brothers boarded ANA with a United Airlines ticket.

subItems.hint:
→ One of the two brothers boarded ANA with a United Airlines ticket.
（ANA 班機折返洛杉磯的主因是什麼？→ 兩兄弟其中一人持聯合航空機票卻登上了 ANA 班機。）
  • 定位：第一段「because one passenger... had boarded the wrong flight」＋第二段「one of whom was an authorized ANA passenger while the other had a United Airlines ticket」。
  • 其他選項：Teigen 的推特（只是插曲）、TSA 發言人（只是說明）、廁所異味（是別的例子，不是本案）。
撇步
  • 問「主因」→ 抓第一段的 because 子句。

subItems.title: 23. Which of the following statements best describes the author's opinion about the flight turning back?

options.text: The passengers should fight for their rights.

subItems.hint:
→ It sounds ridiculous but unavoidable.
（下列何者最能描述作者對班機折返的看法？→ 聽起來荒謬，卻無可避免。）
  • 定位：第四段「Others are unusual, but not unheard of」＋第一段「for reasons still unclear」、第三段「It remains unclear how that happened. The airline said the decision to turn around was part of a security procedure.」
  • 語氣線索：作者用 amused、unusual、not unheard of，語氣是「荒謬但可理解」，沒有譴責。
  • 其他選項：延誤不可接受（作者未這樣說）、退而求其次（不是折返的性質）、乘客應爭權（文中未提）。
撇步
  • 作者態度題抓語氣詞（unusual、amused、not unheard of），不要用自己的立場代入。

subItems.title: 24. Which of the following reasons for diverting a plane has been mentioned in this passage?
subItems.hint:
→ Toilet problems.
（文中提到哪一種班機折返的原因？→ 廁所問題。）
  • 定位：最後一段「an overwhelming odor coming from the lavatory」（廁所異味）＋「a 'very foul smell' coming from the lavatory」。
  • 其他選項：警察到場（是事件後的現象，不是折返原因）、公關噱頭、推特更新（都不是原因）。
撇步
  • 問「mentioned」→ 只找文中明講的，不要推理。

subItems.title: 25. What can be inferred from the passage?

options.text: Most causes of flight delay are beyond control of airlines.
Passengers on board are aware of what they should not do.
Long-haul passengers might get extravagant compensation.
To fly fast and on schedule is the top priority for all airlines.

subItems.hint:
→ Most causes of flight delay are beyond control of airlines.
（可推論出什麼？→ 大多數航班延誤的原因不是航空公司能控制的。）
  • 依據：第四段列出的原因——weather concerns、mechanical problems、medical issues、terrorist threats，加上「上錯飛機」與「廁所異味」——都不是航空公司能預防的。
  • 其他選項：(B) 乘客知道自己不該做什麼——文中乘客根本不知道自己上錯機；(C) 鉅額賠償——文中未提；(D) 準時是最高優先——文中反而顯示安全程序優先於準時。
撇步
  • 推論題要「文中可支持」：把第四段的原因列出來，答案自然浮現。
